ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager's one free afternoon meets a friend who needs help moving baskets: say no kindly, or offer one hour.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has been looking forward to this afternoon all week: no work, nothing planned, just a shady tree and a long nap in the warm air. Then (friend), a good friend, comes over, bright-eyed. "Will you help me move all my baskets to the new storage spot? It'll only take the whole afternoon."

a.name: Answer A
a.text: "I'm sorry," says (subject). "I really need this afternoon to myself. Can I help tomorrow morning instead?" (friend) looks a bit disappointed, then nods. "Tomorrow's fine." (subject) still feels a tiny bit guilty under the tree. Then (subject.he/she) falls asleep, and wakes up feeling much better. The baskets get moved the next morning, and it only takes an hour with two people.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: "I can give you one hour," says (subject). "Then I'm going to lie under a tree and nobody can stop me." (friend) laughs. "Deal." They work hard for exactly one hour. Then (subject) puts down the last basket, walks to (subject.his/her) tree and lies down, and (friend), after a moment's thought, lies down under the next tree over.
